parsed_response.reasoning: The diff adds `totalPages: function() { ... return Math.floor(this.get("user_count") / this.get("limit")) + 1; }` in admin-group.js.es6. When user_count is an exact multiple of limit (e.g. 50 members with limit 50), Math.floor(50/50)+1 = 2, but there is only one page. showingLast (propertyEqual currentPage/totalPages) is thus false on the actual last page, and the `next` action's clamps (`Math.min(group.get("offset") + group.get("limit"), group.get("user_count"))` and findMembers' `Math.min(this.get("user_count"), Math.max(this.get("offset"), 0))`) allow offset == user_count, navigating to an empty page. judged_text: totalPages uses Math.floor(user_count / limit) + 1, which overstates the page count by one whenever limit divides user_count exactly (ceil is required). For a group with exactly 50 or 100 members the admin page shows totalPages of 2/3 and showingLast is false on the real last page, so clicking next (whose clamp Math.min(offset+limit, user_count) at line 33 and findMembers' own Math.min(user_count, offset) clamp both permit offset == user_count) navigates to a page with zero members displayed as 'N/N'; the same empty page appears after removing a member when the count lands on a multiple of the page size.
